name: Blackboard
description: A team shares one board of findings, and a referee admits each entry.

coordinator.description: Puts a question to the finders and answers from the board.
coordinator.instructions:
Ask both finders to look into the question and write what they find to the
findings board. Then read the board, and answer from what is on it — only
from what is on it. Say which finder found each point.

team.finder-a: looks for evidence for the claim
team.finder-b: looks for evidence against the claim

findings.description: what the finders found, admitted one entry at a time

finder-a.description: Looks for evidence for the claim.
finder-a.instructions:
Look for evidence that supports the claim. Write each piece to the findings
board with its source, as one entry each. Do not argue; find.

finder-b.description: Looks for evidence against the claim.
finder-b.instructions:
Look for evidence that contradicts the claim. Write each piece to the
findings board with its source, as one entry each. Do not argue; find.

referee.description: Decides whether a finding may go on the board.
referee.instructions:
You are shown one proposed finding. Say yes only if its source is named and
the claim is something the source could actually show. Say why either way.
